handoff.objective: Inspect cubic-divisor remainder membership as a new F1 formulation removing symmetric multiplicities away from repeated-coordinate strata.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether replacing triple-equal symmetric terminal equations by monic cubic divisibility gives a reduced exact algebra and a more tractable concrete solver input.
constraints: New implementation correctness pass, not a performance experiment or official conclusion.
Use F(t)=D_(2^k)(t)-c with c!=+-2, h=t^3-s1*t^2+s2*t-s3; set the three coefficients of F mod h to zero.
Prove scope on distinct coordinates and handle x=x=x and exactly-two-equal strata separately so no valid repeated point is lost.
Use mod-h repeated squaring to retain a short circuit. Do not infer solving speed from reduced length or a compact circuit.
Keep original F1 evidence immutable. New output only tracks/f1/cubic-divisor/**. Preserve failures.
